Q.7 · The Chalkboard · faithful mock in the current theme

Fully playable from Level7.ts: 33 chalk letters (exactly 13 F's) on a green board, a pink eraser on the desk you can pick up and drag, and four answer buttons. The trick: the correct answer is whichever button matches the number of F's STILL VISIBLE on the board. 13 isn't an option, so you must erase your way to 8, 11, or all the way to 0. "15" is never correct.
